question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"surreptious"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, the incorrectly spelled word is **'surreptious.'**
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'surreptitious.'**
 
• **Surreptitious:** done secretly, without anyone seeing or knowing.
 
 
• **Example:** *A surreptitious glance.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
